verdict: A budget pullback stopped paid leads last week; recovery is in motion.
narrative: In the last 28 days, paid channels tracked 16 leads at a cost of $105.44 per lead, but the final 7 days produced zero paid leads as total spend dropped nearly 50% and Google Ads was cut by 61%. This was a volume problem driven by budget, not by audience or ad performance — the underlying channels were working. Separately, your CRM recorded 763 opportunities and 56 won jobs this period, a figure that far exceeds what paid tracking captured; we are reconciling that gap to ensure no leads are falling through without being attributed. Budget levels are being restored and overdue campaign launches — including heating campaigns and LSA — are being cleared this month ahead of the October 31 scale-up milestone.
